services.name: Pontoon Cruises
services.desc: What secrets do a pelican and a pirate share? Find out on our limited-time Pontoon Night Cruise! Join Cap'n James and his swarthy deck crew for an evening voyage along our bayou. Explore the historic backwaters of Galveston Bay, a perfect, dark refuge for both notorious ne'er-do-wells and the bayou’s own plundering pelicans. Experience the bayou after dark and keep your eyes peeled for the night's mysterious creatures! Teachers can earn 2 SBEC hours for participating in this activity. Please indicate when booking that you would like to receive SBEC hours. blurb: Armand Bayou Nature Center offers interactive outdoor education classes for kids aged 18 months to 18 years, including EcoTots, EcoKids, EcoSchoolers, EcoAdventurers, and EcoTeens. They provide outdoor camps during school breaks and specialized programs for Scouts to earn badges and explore nature. The center also supports educators with TEKS-aligned programs and professional development opportunities.
